assignments.node_id: למסר המלחמה על ה. שה ילחם המלחמה
assignments.reason: The Torah explicitly identifies surrendering the battle to God as a bechina of שתיקה (silence), which is itself a member of Package 1. The text states 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת שְׁתִיקָה, הַיְנוּ שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לִשְׁתֹּק לָהֶם, רַק לִסְמֹךְ עַל ה' — this concept shares the essential nature of the truth-cluster: undivided trust, a single posture of reliance on God with no multiplicity or inner contradiction, which is the defining quality of אמת.

unassigned_nodes.reason: This node's essential nature belongs to the evil domain — it describes the nullification of the wicked's heretical thoughts (מחשבות של כפירות). While the nullification itself is a positive outcome, the concept is defined by its reference to the evil thoughts of the wicked, not by the qualities of truth, charity, or wholeness that characterize Package 1. There is no evil-domain package in this Torah's bechina structure to house it, so it remains unassigned.
